I can do that — quick clarifications before I make any change.

Current event: "Pipeline review", weekly on Thursdays at 9:00 AM America/Chicago.

Which scope do you want?
- A — Only the single occurrence on Thursday, July 16, 2026 → move that one instance to 10:00 AM (other Thursdays remain at 9:00).
- B — That occurrence and all future occurrences from July 16, 2026 onward → change the series going forward to 10:00 AM weekly.
- C — The entire series (all past and future occurrences) → change every Thursday to 10:00 AM.

Confirm these additional details:
- Time zone for the new time: keep America/Chicago? (yes/no or specify)
- Keep the event duration the same? (yes/no)
- Notify attendees of the change? (yes — send update / no — don’t send)
- Any other event named "Pipeline review" I should avoid touching? (if multiple, tell me which one by date or organizer)

Reply with the letter for scope (A/B/C) plus answers to the bullet points and I’ll reschedule.
